s.note: the welcome spread on Miles Bron's island
s.how: Blitz 400g drained chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, lemon and ice water until smooth. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber, garlic and salt for tzatziki. Lay both out with 150g kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes and 4 warm pita breads.

s.note: Blanc stages the big reveal with a bottle of it
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Blitz 6 red chillies with 3 garlic cloves, 80ml vinegar and 2 tbsp honey, simmer 5 minutes and toss through the wings. Serve with celery and 150g blue cheese stirred into 150g sour cream.

m.how: Cut 800g lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Serve in 4 warm pitas with 250g Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.

w.note: the pineapple juice slipped into Duke's drink
w.how: Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar in a 23cm tin and lay over 8 pineapple rings from a 440g tin. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 175g self-raising flour and 80ml pineapple juice. Spread over and bake at 180C for 40 minutes, then turn out while warm.

d.note: the welcome drinks by Miles's pool
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime. Pour 250ml cold ginger kombucha into each and add 30ml vodka to the glasses of anyone who wants it spiked. Stir once and serve straight away.
